event_records.description: The first meeting of the season of the Aurora Block tenants' association begins.

tenants_association_of_the_aurora_block.name: Tenants' Association of the Aurora Block
tenants_association_of_the_aurora_block.persona_brief:
You are Tenants' Association of the Aurora Block.
The association is holding its first meeting of the season tonight. It needs to elect a treasurer. Three residents have expressed interest in the role.

resolution.question: Will the tenants' association of the Aurora Block elect a treasurer at tonight's first meeting of the season, given that three residents have shown interest?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that a treasurer was elected by the association during the meeting before the cutoff at 21:30. Otherwise resolve NO.
